items.name: Sentinel's Oath-Ring
items.lore: The ring a Friend of the Sentinels is given: bronze, with the south road's milestone on it.

items.name: South-Road Belt
items.lore: A Sentinel's belt, scuffed from a thousand miles of road.

items.name: Ceannai Torc
items.lore: Bronze, with the town's gate worked into the clasp.

items.name: Treaty-Keeper Bracer
items.lore: Stamped with the ogham of the old treaty. It's meant to remind you.

items.name: Mantle of Ceannai
items.lore: Ceannai blue and silver. Only the Captains of Ceannai wear it.

items.name: Well-Friend's Charm
items.lore: A hazelnut on a silver chain. The well's people know it.

items.name: Fili's Reed Belt
items.lore: Woven of marsh reed, the way the filid do it.

items.name: Nine-Hazel Torc
items.lore: Hazel wood from all nine trees, bound in silver.

items.name: Still-Water Bracer
items.lore: Glass-smooth stone from the well's bed. It's always cool.

items.name: Mantle of Connla's Well
items.lore: Green and silver, embroidered with hazel leaves. Only the Filid of Connla's Well wear it.
